scripts.db:restart: npm run db:reset && npm run db:migrate:dev && npm run db:seed:dev
scripts.db:generate: dotenvx run -f ../../.env.local -- sh -c 'for config in src/modules/*/database.config.ts src/link-modules/database.config.ts; do drizzle-kit generate --config="$config" || exit 1; done'
scripts.db:migrate: MIGRATING=true sh -c 'for config in src/modules/*/database.config.ts src/link-modules/database.config.ts; do drizzle-kit migrate --config="$config" || exit 1; done'
scripts.openapi:dump: curl -s http://localhost:3000/admin/openapi.json | python3 -m json.tool > openapi/openapi-admin.json && curl -s http://localhost:3000/store/openapi.json | python3 -m json.tool > openapi/openapi-store.json && echo 'Saved openapi/openapi-admin.json and openapi/openapi-store.json'
scripts.check:deps:graph: depcruise src/ --config deps-analyzer/.dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type archi --exclude '(node_modules|__tests__)' --collapse 3 | dot -T svg -o deps-analyzer/dependency-graph.svg && open deps-analyzer/dependency-graph.svg
